test_added: src/core/board/board.zig:739-762 — two tests. "candidates of an empty board are every digit" asserts all 81 cells of a fresh board answer ALL_DIGITS (full nine-bit set); "candidates drop a digit placed in the row, the column and the box" fills (4,0)=1 (same row), (0,4)=2 (same column), (3,3)=3 (same box, neither row nor col) and (8,8)=4 (none of the three), asserts candidates(4,4) equals ALL_DIGITS minus exactly digits 1-3, and asserts digit 4 is still present — so both the removal and the non-removal of an out-of-scope digit are pinned.
